breakdown.description: The prompt assumes equal span implies equal force sharing, but the load split in parallel bars depends on the relative axial stiffnesses AE/L.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly stated to split the load equally. The ground truth removed this erroneous instruction. The agent correctly ignored the user's flawed method and instead specified that the load is shared in proportion to the bars' axial stiffnesses, which is the correct physical principle.

breakdown.description: The prompt adds the two bar elongations to get the plate displacement, even though parallel bars between rigid plates undergo the same elongation.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly instructed to add the two bar elongations. The ground truth removed this instruction. The agent correctly identified that the bars undergo the same, common elongation because they are mounted in parallel between rigid plates, and calculated this single value instead of adding non-existent separate elongations.
